catalog.admission: Catalog admission requires a selected profile, an open Catalog database/source identity joined to the current publish receipt, established producer profile-input coverage, and the requested row profile ID to be included. Unknown/malformed/legacy coverage refuses plan admission.
catalog.known_gap: No current-HEAD TestClient run binds the profile-specific real Catalog fixture through /api/v1/control/data/resolve and its fresh Catalog reader in the supplied R1042 receipt.
catalog.selection: ControlPlaneService.data_resolve validates supplied/configured profile, refuses conflict with 422, and forwards the selected profile. RetrievalService compares request/profile inputs and does not promote missing profile to an admitted catalog currentness result.
catalog.separate_surface: CatalogServingSourceSelection is an app-level explicit path/profile selector marked candidate-only; path selection alone is not currentness.
catalog.test_evidence: Current test source contains real Catalog fixture positive plus missing profile typed refusal in test_control_service_preserves_real_catalog_ownership; server profile conflict tests; actual currentness/coverage and malformed/missing selection tests. These are source expectations only in this R1041 artifact, not a command result.
catalog.typed_request: DataResolveRequest.catalog_run_profile is optional CatalogRunProfile Literal and extra-forbid; /api/v1/control/data/resolve accepts that request type.

legal.fresh_consumer: Search reconstructs canonical inventory, checks the fresh selected generation ID and full inventory bytes, current member set, saved index/matrix binding, expected model/device/dimension and current encoder assets before vector results; missing/malformed/stale inputs stay text mode with a typed refusal.
legal.producer_bridge: selected_legal_fact_query_intent reads the persisted selected, complete Legal fact generation and serializes the selected inventory snapshot into the typed intent; available status is documented as a snapshot only.
legal.scope: The distinct DTOs match separate Catalog DataResolve and Legal Lex search surfaces. No evidence says a single LexSearchRequest must also carry CatalogRunProfile.
legal.typed_request: LegalQueryGenerationIntentV1 is frozen and extra-forbid; LexSearchRequest carries a tuple of those Legal intents, with no CatalogRunProfile field.

decision.catalog_leg: Source-level path is present: typed DataResolveRequest profile -> current ControlPlaneService validation/config selection -> RetrievalService currentness/profile-coverage gates. Current tests include a real Catalog fixture positive and missing-profile refusal at the service boundary, but those Catalog tests were not run in R1042 or by this review. The existing TestClient /data/resolve test checks generic response shape, not profile-specific Catalog currentness.
decision.legal_leg: R1042 provides a bounded controlled synthetic producer -> persisted selected generation -> immutable request intent -> fresh Legal reader -> actual HTTP vector/text response receipt, including typed malformed/missing/stale fallback.
decision.next_root_check: A focused current-HEAD Catalog route/currentness wave is the concrete remaining evidence action if the public route is in the I4 acceptance surface. Use existing DataResolveRequest and Catalog profile APIs; do not invent a coupled Legal DTO. Run real Catalog fixture positive, absent/wrong/conflicting profile refusals, and currentness/profile-coverage negatives through the actual selected request/reader boundary.
decision.overall: No formal I4 closure is supported by this review. The current code shows two separate typed request paths; a combined CatalogRunProfile+LegalQueryGenerationIntent DTO is not an original criterion and is not required by the evidence.
scope_limits: No LA-032, LA-033, LA-046, or Catalog test execution by this review
